title: egami-video metadata
description: What 'egami-video metadata' writes, and what 'egami-video metadata --load' reads: a media file's tags, chapters, track names, languages and default flags, and attachment names. --load takes the whole document (with one file, or the file whose path names the input) or one file object; keys it leaves out stay as they were unless --clear is given.

tags.description: Text tags keyed by Matroska tag name (TITLE, ARTIST, COMMENT, DATE and so on). On --load a null value removes the tag; numbers and true or false are stored as text.

time.description: Seconds, or on --load also text as the command line writes times: 90.5, 1:30 or 01:02:03.250.

path.description: The input as given on the command line; --load uses it to find the input's entry when there are several.

format.description: The container, such as Matroska or MP4. Ignored by --load.

duration.description: The duration in seconds, or null. Ignored by --load.

chapters.description: The chapters in time order. On --load the list replaces the file's chapters.

end.description: When the chapter ends, or null when the file does not say.

language.description: The title's language, such as eng.

tracks.description: The tracks. On --load each entry changes the track with its number (or its index, or its position in the list); the fields it has replace the track's.

number.description: The track number, as 'egami-video info' shows it.

index.description: The track's position in the file, from 0.

language.description: An IETF BCP 47 or ISO 639-2 language, or null.

default.description: Whether players pick the track by default.

attachments.description: The attached files. On --load the list keeps the attachments it names (and sets their descriptions) and drops the others; it cannot add files ('egami-video embed --attach' does).

coverArt.description: Whether it is cover art (named cover, small_cover, cover_land or small_cover_land). Ignored by --load.
